# single.estimate_single_trial { #fmrimod.single.estimate_single_trial }

```python
estimate_single_trial(
    Y,
    X,
    method='lss',
    confounds=None,
    trial_labels=None,
    return_se=False,
    *,
    prewhiten=None,
    nuisance_projector=None,
    chunk_size=None,
    oasis_config=None,
    sbhm_config=None,
    sbhm_library=None,
    baseline_regressors=None,
    include_intercept=False,
)
```

Estimate per-trial betas using the specified method.

This is the main dispatcher for single-trial estimation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                                                      | Description                                                                                                          | Default    |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Y                   | NDArray, shape ``(n, V)``                                 | Data matrix (time x voxels).                                                                                         | _required_ |
| X                   | NDArray, shape ``(n, n_trials)`` or ``(n, n_trials * K)`` | Trial regressor matrix (already convolved with HRF).                                                                 | _required_ |
| method              | SingleTrialMethod or literal string                       | One of ``"lss"``, ``"lsa"``, ``"oasis"``, ``"sbhm"``, ``"mixed"``.                                                   | `'lss'`    |
| confounds           | NDArray, shape ``(n, q)``                                 | Nuisance regressors (motion, drift, etc.).                                                                           | `None`     |
| trial_labels        | list of str                                               | Labels identifying each trial.                                                                                       | `None`     |
| return_se           | bool                                                      | Whether to compute standard errors (not all methods support this).                                                   | `False`    |
| prewhiten           | PrewhitenConfig                                           | If provided, AR-based prewhitening is applied to Y, X, and confounds before estimation.                              | `None`     |
| nuisance_projector  | NuisanceProjector                                         | Precomputed nuisance projector for LSS. Useful when reusing the same confound matrix across repeated LSS fits.       | `None`     |
| chunk_size          | int                                                       | Voxel chunk size for LSS beta-only solves.                                                                           | `None`     |
| oasis_config        | OasisConfig                                               | Configuration for the OASIS solver.                                                                                  | `None`     |
| sbhm_config         | SbhmConfig                                                | Configuration for the SBHM pipeline.                                                                                 | `None`     |
| sbhm_library        | SbhmLibrary                                               | Pre-built SBHM library (required for SBHM method).                                                                   | `None`     |
| baseline_regressors | NDArray, shape ``(n, p)``                                 | Baseline or experimental regressors included in every LSS model. Equivalent to the ``Z`` matrix in ``fmrilss::lss``. | `None`     |
| include_intercept   | bool                                                      | Add an intercept to the LSS adjustment design.                                                                       | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type              | Description   |
|--------|-------------------|---------------|
|        | SingleTrialResult |               |
